references.title: DPLL with Caching: A New Algorithm for #SAT and Bayesian Inference
references.source: Electronic Colloquium on Computational Complexity, TR03-003
references.note: Primary algorithmic source showing how residual/component memoization converts backtracking into dynamic programming and can yield exponential savings when identical subproblems recur; it does not establish polynomial-time SAT.

references.title: Memoization and DPLL: Formula Caching Proof Systems
references.source: Proceedings of the 18th IEEE Conference on Computational Complexity, 225-236
references.note: Primary proof-complexity source distinguishing exact/basic Formula Caching from reason-caching and DAG Resolution; basic caching is polynomially equivalent to contradiction caching, while reason-augmented variants can be substantially stronger.
